name: invoice-automation-saas
description: Production-grade multi-business invoicing and financial operations software built with Next.js, Node.js, and Supabase/PostgreSQL.

scripts.cap:doctor: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap doctor
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:open:android: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:build:android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && (gradlew.bat bundleDebug || ./gradlew bundleDebug)
scripts.cap:build:android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && (gradlew.bat bundleRelease -PrequireReleaseSigning=true || ./gradlew bundleRelease -PrequireReleaseSigning=true)
